summary: Swipe Savvy, Inc., founded in 2020 by CEO Jason Mayoral and headquartered in Orlando, FL, provides a unified cloud POS, payments, loyalty (tiered points, birthday/streak/referral rewards, cross-merchant Rewards Wallet), and AI-analytics (SavvyAI) platform marketed across 18+ industries including restaurants, starting at $69/month for its all-in-one tier.

Swipe Savvy acquired restaurant-focused social-impact marketing platform GiftAMeal on April 1, 2026, to expand its loyalty/engagement offering; GiftAMeal had partnered with more than 1,200 restaurant locations across 46 states, generating nearly 3 million donated meals through 185 local food banks via a QR-code photo-sharing donation mechanic.
